clue.text: Being ingenuous he left without a suit

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Being ingenuous he left without a suit (7)': ART (being) + LESS (without) covers part, but 'he left' and 'a suit' have no job; the clue looks garbled and no source gives the printed text.
annotationWithheld.clue: Being ingenuous he left without a suit

clue.text: Nearly opposite

parts.note: the word meant is the opposite of 'nearly' in the sense of distance: far off, only slightly, at a great remove

explanation.definitionFit: The adverb means distantly or far away, which is the reverse of near at hand.

clue.text: Making money, pound first while receiving tuition

indicators.note: first says the pound symbol comes at the very front of the word for making money

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for pound sterling, from Latin libra
making money means earning

explanation.surface: Someone earns money but must pay a pound up front while taking lessons.
explanation.definitionFit: Being taught or studying is the state of acquiring knowledge from a teacher.

clue.text: Hold hands

parts.note: read not as lovers clasping fingers but as hands (workers) for a ship's hold, the dockers who load cargo

explanation.definitionFit: Dock labourers who load and unload ships' cargo are workers for the hold.

clue.text: Painter right to leave a gory mess?

indicators.note: a mess is a jumble, so the remaining letters are thrown into a new order
to leave tells us the letter for right departs from the words a gory

explanation.surface: A painter of grisly scenes makes a bloody mess of the canvas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to leave' takes R out of A GORY, leaving AGOY, which 'mess' rearranges. Fitting, since the Spanish painter is famous for gory war scenes.
explanation.definitionFit: Francisco Goya was the Spanish artist of the Disasters of War etchings.

clue.text: Many an unsuccessful competitor is not so far away

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a crossword stand-in for many
one who fails to win is a loser

explanation.surface: A remark that most of those who lose a race were not far behind.
explanation.definitionFit: Comparative of near: at a smaller distance than something else.

clue.text: Instance about rotter at the waterfall

indicators.note: about means the word for instance goes round the word for rotter

parts.note: an instance is a case
a rotter, a dishonourable man, is a cad

explanation.surface: A scoundrel turns up at the falls in some story.
explanation.walkthrough: CAD is old British slang for a man who behaves badly, especially towards women.
explanation.definitionFit: A series of small falls of water tumbling over rocks is a cascade.

clue.text: He should be an expert piper

definitions.text: He should be an expert piper

parts.words: He should be an expert piper
parts.note: a piper is not a bagpipe player here but someone who works with pipes, fitting and mending them

explanation.definitionFit: A tradesman who installs and repairs water pipes must know them well.

clue.text: Check-up presently made?

parts.note: presently is read as 'concerning who is present': a check made on attendance by reading names aloud

explanation.definitionFit: A roll call is a reading of a list of names to confirm attendance.

clue.text: I am with buddy Edwin who was transfixed

parts.note: I am contracts to I'm
a buddy is a pal
Ed is a short form of the name Edwin

explanation.surface: Someone with a friend called Edwin who stood frozen to the spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Pierced through by a spike or stake, as a transfixed creature is.

clue.text: Red or green pepper with chopped aspic inside

indicators.note: inside says the jumbled letters of aspic sit within the Latin word for with

parts.note: cum is Latin for with, as in 'kitchen-cum-dining room'

indicators.note: chopped means cut up, so the letters of aspic are rearranged

explanation.surface: A recipe: pepper served with chopped savoury jelly inside it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' as the Latin CUM is the trick here; 'Red or green pepper' might seem to be describing a jelly, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Capsicum is the plant genus of sweet peppers, which ripen from green to red.

clue.text: After church, middle easterner can remove old vehicle

indicators.note: after church means the following pieces come behind the abbreviation for church

parts.note: an Arab is a person from the Middle East

indicators.note: remove is read as re-move, moving the letters of can again into a new order

explanation.surface: After the service, a man from the Middle East is able to tow away an old car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'remove' rearranges CAN into ANC. A charabanc was an early open motor coach used for British day trips.
explanation.definitionFit: A charabanc was an early open-topped motor coach for outings.

clue.text: Make up about hundred now

indicators.note: about means the phrase for make up goes round the numeral for hundred

parts.note: to make up for a wrong is to atone
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: An urgent order to make amends for a hundred things right now.
explanation.definitionFit: Immediately, without delay, is the sense of the phrase.

clue.text: Neither win nor lose game at entrance

parts.note: a match with neither side winning is a draw
bridge is a card game

explanation.surface: A match ends level at the gates of the venue.
explanation.definitionFit: A hinged bridge over a castle moat forms the way in.

clue.text: One who is moving one fish for the bird

parts.note: to budge is to move, so one who moves is a budger
I is the Roman numeral for one
the gar is a long-snouted fish

explanation.surface: Someone shifting a fish to feed a pet bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The Australian parakeet often kept as a cage pet.

clue.text: Scheme to get alien off earth

indicators.note: off means the letters for alien are taken away from the word for earth

parts.note: Earth is a planet
ET, the film's extra-terrestrial, is the crossword's usual alien

explanation.surface: A plot to drive an alien off our world.
explanation.definitionFit: A plan is a scheme or design for doing something.

clue.text: Herb, continental red variety

parts.note: a German is a person from the European continent

indicators.note: variety signals a different arrangement of the letters of red

explanation.surface: A herb of a red-flowered European kind.
explanation.definitionFit: Germander is a plant of the mint family, used as a medicinal herb.

clue.text: Again, joined one in a rush

indicators.note: in places the word for one within the word for a rush

parts.note: a rush is a marsh plant, a reed
a single thing is a unit

explanation.surface: Joined together once more in a hurry.
explanation.definitionFit: Brought together once more after separation.

clue.text: Angle for agitation atin old pond

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Angle for agitation atin old pond (4,4)': 'atin' is garbled and no definition for the dish can be separated from FISH (angle) and STEW (agitation; old pond).
annotationWithheld.clue: Angle for agitation atin old pond

clue.text: It's no business trip for lady on woodland path

parts.note: Joy is a woman's name
a ride is a track through woodland for horse riders

explanation.surface: A woman out on a woodland track for pleasure, not work.
explanation.walkthrough: A ride as a forest track is a British usage.
explanation.definitionFit: A reckless drive in a stolen car taken for fun, never for work.

clue.text: List articles Tim is with ease, say, moving

indicators.note: moving signals that the letters are shifted into a new order

parts.note: ease said aloud sounds like E's, two letter Es

explanation.surface: Tim lists items with ease.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving' shuffles TIM, IS and the two Es that 'ease, say' gives into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To set down things one by one in an itemised list.

clue.text: Inside out sign

parts.note: not a reversal: a sign found inside a building showing the way out

explanation.definitionFit: A notice over a doorway marking the way out of a building.

clue.text: Not in good form?

parts.note: can mean unfit and also bent or misshapen

explanation.definitionFit: Unfit physically, or literally distorted from its proper outline.

clue.text: Liking the Parisian caress

parts.note: having a liking for is being fond
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Fondness for the French way of caressing.
explanation.definitionFit: To stroke or touch lovingly.

clue.text: Anchor removed from rude hut for travellers

indicators.note: removed read as re-moved: the letters of anchor are moved again into another order

explanation.surface: A ship's anchor taken away from a rough shelter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'removed' shuffles the letters of ANCHOR. Rude here means roughly built.
explanation.definitionFit: In Spanish America a rancho is a crude hut where travellers can stop.

clue.text: Involving love that's imaginary

explanation.surface: Love that exists only in someone's dreams.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers amorous feelings and also fanciful or idealised notions.

clue.text: Not far from minchinhampton

indicators.note: from tells us to take the letters out of the place name minchinhampton

explanation.surface: Somewhere close to a Gloucestershire town.
explanation.walkthrough: Minchinhampton is a small town in Gloucestershire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny distance, as in 'not budge an inch'.

clue.text: Notedly stirring?

parts.note: notedly means in musical notes: a direction to play in an excited, agitated way

explanation.definitionFit: An Italian musical marking telling the player to perform restlessly and excitedly.

clue.text: Shift from the underworld?

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld, so a place there is Dis's place: shift means move from position

explanation.definitionFit: To move something out of its usual position.

clue.text: Tool used to nail everything, say

parts.note: a brad is a thin small-headed nail

indicators.note: say signals that the word for everything is to be heard, not spelt

parts.note: everything means all

explanation.surface: A tool used to drive nails into everything.
explanation.definitionFit: A small pointed hand tool for making holes in wood before nailing.
